hero-label: Core Banking Software for South African CFIs
hero-h1: Banking software built for the institutions that put people first.
hero-copy: Paxiss is purpose-built core banking for South African cooperative financial institutions. Fully customisable, locally supported. From a Pretoria team with 40 years experience in banking.
feat-h2:
Everything a CFI needs.
Nothing it doesn't.
feat-copy: Paxiss covers the full operational surface of a regulated cooperative financial institution, built so your team can run confidently from day one.
feat-cb-1-body: Capture and maintain comprehensive client profile information, including personal details, contact information, identification records, account relationships, and regulatory data.
feat-cb-2-body: Open, maintain, and manage accounts for all product types offered by the institution. Account functionality is driven by product definitions and client eligibility criteria.
feat-cb-3-body: A comprehensive engine supporting deposits, withdrawals, transfers, payments, and fund transfers to external institutions. Also supports sundry transactions between general ledger accounts, as well as suspended, deferred, and automated transactions.
feat-cb-4-body: Automate recurring client transactions based on predefined schedules. Instructions can continue indefinitely or terminate automatically when specified end criteria are met.
feat-cb-5-body: Manage and control cash holdings issued to officials from the treasury. Tracks cash balances by denomination, records all movements, and supports end-of-day balancing and reconciliation. Multiple teller positions with full support for cash transfers between tellers and the treasury.
feat-pp-1-body: A flexible, user-definable product configuration facility that enables the institution to create and maintain unique financial products across various product classes, including savings, loans, investments, and transactional accounts.
feat-pp-2-body: Interest structures are dynamically configurable on a per-product basis. Define and maintain interest calculation methods, rates, and related parameters for each product, allowing the system to automatically calculate and apply interest according to product-specific rules.
feat-pp-3-body: Fees are fully user-definable, allowing authorised officials to configure fee structures and the rules governing their application. The system automatically calculates and applies the appropriate fees to transactions.
feat-fm-1-body: A fully integrated general ledger facility automatically records all accounting entries arising from transactions, ensuring complete financial integrity and real-time financial reporting.
feat-fm-2-body: Authorised and mandated officials can perform controlled financial transactions directly between general ledger accounts, supporting operational and administrative financial activities.
feat-sr-1-body: Manage member shareholdings, including the issuance, maintenance, transfer, and redemption of shares. The system also supports the printing and management of share certificates.
feat-sr-2-body: Capture and maintain relationships between clients, accounts, and related parties, such as representatives, signatories, trustees, beneficiaries, and guardians. All compliance requirements applicable to clients are automatically enforced for related parties.
feat-sr-3-body: Manage and track pledged (ceded) accounts, including the registration, maintenance, and monitoring of third-party cessions and associated account restrictions.
feat-cr-1-body: Comprehensive FICA management for all profiles, including clients and related parties. FICA-related documentation is stored electronically within the system for compliance, verification, and audit purposes.
feat-cr-2-body: Supports all data capture, validation, reporting, and submission requirements necessary to comply with the South African Corporation for Deposit Insurance (CODI) regulations.
feat-cr-3-body: Ensures the capture and maintenance of all information required to meet regulatory, governance, and compliance obligations.
feat-dr-1-body: Integrated document management for storing and managing client-related documents, including contracts, wills, trust deeds, identification documents, share certificates, and other supporting records directly within the system.
feat-dr-2-body: Secure storage and retrieval of supporting documentation and historical records, providing a complete audit trail for regulatory and operational purposes.
feat-sc-1-body: Role-based security enables administrators to control access to functions, data, and transactions based on user roles and responsibilities.
feat-sc-2-body: Allows authorised officials to temporarily delegate specific rights and responsibilities to other officials under controlled and auditable conditions.
feat-sc-3-body: Comprehensive audit and forensic tracking records all user activities, transactions, approvals, amendments, and system access. The system maintains a complete audit trail showing who performed each action, when it was performed, and from which workstation or facility.
feat-sc-4-body: Provides visibility into user activity, system usage, transaction history, and operational events to support governance, oversight, and risk management.
feat-ml-1-body: Dynamically switch the system between English and Afrikaans, with all screens, menus, messages, and reports displayed in the selected language.
feat-ben-2: Fully integrated accounting and general ledger
feat-ben-3: User-definable products, fees, and interest structures
feat-ben-11: Real-time transaction processing and financial posting

faq-h2: Questions worth asking before you decide.
faq-q1: Is Paxiss compliant with the Prudential Authority and Cooperative Banks Act requirements?
faq-a1: Yes. Paxiss is purpose-built for the South African regulatory environment. The system includes FICA compliance tools, CODI-compliant reporting, and audit infrastructure designed specifically for registered cooperative financial institutions under the Cooperative Banks Act No. 40 of 2007. Compliance is not an add-on module. It is baked into how the system works.
faq-q2: Can Paxiss be deployed on our own servers, or is it only available as a cloud service?
faq-a2: Both. Paxiss offers a fully managed SaaS deployment or an in-house installation on your own infrastructure. The decision comes down to your IT capacity, data governance preferences, and regulatory context. Our team will help you work through that during your free consultation, honestly and without pressure toward either option.
faq-q3: How long does implementation take, and what support is provided during onboarding?
faq-a3: Timelines vary based on the institution's size, existing systems, and the modules required. IDE Systems provides hands-on onboarding throughout: data migration assistance, staff training, and post-go-live support. Implementation is treated as a partnership handoff, not a contract fulfilment. You don't go live until you're confident.
faq-q4: Can the system be customised to our institution's specific products and workflows?
faq-a4: Yes. Full customisation is one of the core differences between Paxiss and commercial banking software. No two cooperative institutions are structured identically. Paxiss adapts to your specific loan products, savings structures, member management workflows, and governance model. Customisation is part of the implementation, not an expensive extra.
faq-q5: What languages does Paxiss support, and is it accessible to members in rural areas?
faq-a5: Paxiss supports English and Afrikaans across the platform. This matters for institutions serving communities in predominantly Afrikaans-speaking regions, or where operational staff require Afrikaans interfaces. Additional language support can be scoped based on the institution's needs. The platform is web-accessible, meaning staff in rural branches can work from any internet-connected device.
faq-q6: How does Paxiss handle FICA compliance and CODI reporting?
faq-a6: FICA compliance tools are built into the member onboarding and transaction workflows. Customer due diligence, KYC record management, and transaction monitoring are part of the daily process, not a separate compliance layer managed elsewhere. CODI reporting is automated through the general ledger module, generating compliant financial statements directly from live data. Month-end reporting stops being a crisis.
